name: @credithub/jurischain
description: Instead of challenging the humans at the terminals, it would be better to challenge the terminals. It is about balancing the load with customers so as not to suffer a DDoS attack. Inspired by blockchain technology.

scripts.minify: npm run transpile && terser dist/jurischain-bundle.js --ecma 5 --compress passes=3,dead_code,collapse_vars,reduce_vars --mangle -o dist/jurischain-bundle.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run minify && npm run test:browser
scripts.prepack: npm run minify && npm run test:browser
